get.description: ListActiveAgents returns the open sessions of all organizations in one group for each Role, with the slot counts and the limits of the config.

post.description: StartCheck starts the local check of a session that waits for a low load at once. The check ignores the load for this run. It returns 409 when the session does not wait for a low load.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the session
parameters.name: id

get.description: GetTranscript returns the Transcript of a session, the oldest row first.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the session
parameters.name: id

get.description: GetChat returns a page of the messages of the Lead chat of a Workstream, or of the Triager chat of an organization.

parameters.description: Organization is the owner of the repository, or the organization of the Triager chat
parameters.name: organization

parameters.description: Repository is the repository of the Workstream as "owner/name". It is empty for the Triager chat
parameters.name: repository

parameters.description: Workstream is the number of the Workstream issue. It is 0 for the Triager chat
parameters.name: workstream

parameters.description: Before is the id of a message. The page has at most 20 messages with an id below Before. With no Before, the page has the newest 20 messages
parameters.name: before

post.description: SendChat adds a message of the Owner with its images to the chat, and gives it to the Lead or to the Triager. Mobius starts the agent when none runs. A message with the id of a stored message changes nothing and returns the same status. It returns 400 when the request is larger than 4 images of 5 MB with the text. It returns 409 when the organization has no repository of Mobius, or while Mobius restarts for an upgrade.

get.description: GetChatImage returns an image of a message. It returns 404 when the message has no such image.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the message
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Position is the position of the image in the message, from 0
parameters.name: position

post.description: SeeChat records that the Owner saw the messages of the chat up to a message. An earlier message than the last seen message changes nothing.
StopChat stops the turn of the agent that answers a message of the Owner. A turn for a Lead event goes on. When the agent waits for its slot, its first message of the Owner gets no turn.

get.description: GetCheckup returns the status of the App permissions and of each Mobius label in each repository of the organization.

parameters.description: Organization is the owner of the repositories
parameters.name: organization

post.description: FixLabels creates the missing Mobius labels and sets the fixed color of each Mobius label with a different color, in each repository of the organization. The description of an existing label stays.

get.description: GetCheckupTools returns the path and the version of each program that Mobius runs for its agents and its work.
ListDevices returns the device logins.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the device login
parameters.name: id

get.description: GetDrain returns the state of the drain.

post.description: StartDrain holds each new Worker in the queue, and returns when no agent runs or when the Owner cancels the drain.

delete.description: CancelDrain ends the drain, so the held Workers start. It does nothing while the upgrade replaces the program.

get.description: StreamEvents sends the latest activities, and then each new activity, each change of a session, each new or changed Transcript row, each change of the drain, each start and failure of an upgrade, each change of the Workstream list, each new or longer chat message, each new unread count, each change of the state of a chat, each new or dismissed Inbox item, and each Workstream that the Triager chat created. It also sends a ping at a fixed interval. When the request has Last-Event-ID, it sends the activities after that id in place of the latest activities. When the client does not read the session changes fast enough, the stream ends.

parameters.description: LastEventID is the id of the last activity that the client got
parameters.name: Last-Event-ID

get.description: ListGitHubApps returns the Mobius Apps with the repositories of their installations.

post.description: CreateManifestForm returns the form that creates a Mobius App in a GitHub account. After the form, GitHub sends the browser to GET /api/github/manifest-callback.

get.description: ManifestCallback is the page where GitHub sends the browser after it creates the App of a manifest form.

parameters.description: Code is the code that converts the manifest into an App
parameters.name: code

parameters.description: State is the state of the manifest form
parameters.name: state

Location.description: Location is the page that the browser opens next

get.description: UserCallback is the page where GitHub sends the browser after the Owner authorizes a Mobius App. GitHub sends no state after an installation, so the check of the user login protects this page.

parameters.description: Code is the code that GitHub exchanges for a user token
parameters.name: code

Location.description: Location is the page that the browser opens next

get.description: GetHealth returns the state of the server.
ListInbox returns the Inbox items that the Owner did not dismiss, the oldest first.

post.description: Dismiss removes an item from the Inbox.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the Inbox item
parameters.name: id

post.description: Resume ends the pause of a Harness now, so the sessions that wait for it send their prompts again. It also closes the Inbox item.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the usage-limit Inbox item of the pause
parameters.name: id

post.description: Login makes a device login when the password is the access password, and sets the token of the device login in a cookie.

parameters.description: UserAgent names the browser of the device
parameters.name: User-Agent

get.description: ListNeedsHuman returns the open issues of trusted authors with mobius:needs-human or mobius:question in the trees of all Workstreams, from the local copy of GitHub, by repository, Workstream and number.
ListOrganizations returns the owners of the repositories of the Mobius Apps, sorted.
GetRelease returns the newest release of Mobius when it is newer than this program.
ListReleaseChanges returns the first line of the message of each commit after this release up to the newest release of Mobius, the newest first.

post.description: ResumeIssue replaces mobius:needs-human of an issue with mobius:ready, so Mobius continues the task. Mobius changes the labels with the user token of the Owner, so the Owner must authorize the Mobius App first. It returns 409 with the steps when the Owner did not.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the issue
parameters.name: number

post.description: StartIssue adds mobius:ready to an issue, so Mobius starts the task. Mobius adds the label with the user token of the Owner, so the Owner must authorize the Mobius App first. It returns 409 with the steps when the Owner did not.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the issue
parameters.name: number

get.description: ListMemoryVersions returns the versions of the memory file of the repository, the newest first, each with the result of the check of its revert. The first version is the current text of the file. It returns 404 when the repository is not a repository of Mobius.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

put.description: SaveMemory saves the text as the memory file of the repository and adds a version with the author owner. It does nothing when the text does not change. It returns 404 when the repository is not a repository of Mobius, 409 when a newer version exists than the base version, and 422 when the text has more than 200 lines.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

post.description: RevertMemory undoes the change of the version in the current text of the memory file and saves the result as a new version with the author owner. It returns 404 when the repository is not a repository of Mobius, or when the version does not exist or belongs to another repository. It returns 409 when a later version changed the part, when the revert changes nothing, or when the result has more than 200 lines.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: ID is the id of the version to revert
parameters.name: id

get.description: ListUnread returns each chat with unread messages.
GetUpgrade returns the error of the last upgrade.

post.description: StartUpgrade downloads the newest release, drains the agents, and restarts Mobius with the new release. It returns drained when the new release starts, and cancelled when the Owner cancels the drain. The upgrade goes on when the client closes the request.

get.description: GetUsage returns the tokens and the cost of the turns that started in the period.

parameters.description: From is the start of the period. A turn is in the period when it started at From or later
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: To is the end of the period. A turn is in the period when it started before To
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Tz is the IANA name of the time zone for the days. The default is UTC
parameters.name: tz

parameters.description: Harness limits the rows to these Harnesses
parameters.name: harness

parameters.description: Model limits the rows to these models. The model is the model that the Harness reports, or the model of the config when the Harness reports none
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: Effort limits the rows to these efforts
parameters.name: effort

parameters.description: Role limits the rows to these roles
parameters.name: role

parameters.description: Repository limits the rows to these repositories as "owner/name"
parameters.name: repository

parameters.description: Group is the value that splits the days and the groups. With no Group, all rows are in one group
parameters.name: group

get.description: ListWorkstreams returns the open Workstreams from the local copy of GitHub, by repository and the newest first. The copy can be one poll interval old.
ListAgents returns the sessions of a Workstream, the oldest first. Each session has the session that started it as its parent.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue
parameters.name: number

put.description: SetAutopilot turns Autopilot of the Workstream on or off. Mobius changes mobius:autopilot with the user token of the Owner, so the Owner must authorize the Mobius App first. It returns 409 with the steps when the Owner did not.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue
parameters.name: number

post.description: CloseWorkstream closes the Workstream as "won't do", also when it has open issues. For each item of WorkstreamClosure, Mobius adds a comment and mobius:wont-do, and closes the item. It closes the Workstream issue last. It returns 409 when the issue is not an open Workstream.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue
parameters.name: number

get.description: WorkstreamClosure returns the items that CloseWorkstream closes, in the order of the close: the open pull requests of the tasks, the open task issues, and the Workstream issue. It reads the state from GitHub. It returns 409 when the issue is not an open Workstream.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue
parameters.name: number

post.description: CompleteWorkstream closes the Workstream issue as completed. Then Mobius ends the work of the Workstream, closes the open pull requests of its tasks, and closes the open issues below it. It returns 409 when the issue is not an open Workstream, or when the Workstream has no task or an open task.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue
parameters.name: number

get.description: GetWorkstreamDetails returns the creation time, the state and the task counts of a Workstream. It reads GitHub, so it works also for a closed Workstream. A task is an issue in the sub-issue tree of the Workstream, at each depth. It returns 409 when the issue is not a Workstream.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue
parameters.name: number

get.description: ListTasks returns the open and closed tasks of trusted authors in the tree of a Workstream, from the local copy of GitHub. A nested task follows its parent. The copy can be one poll interval old.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue
parameters.name: number

version.description: Version is the tag of the newest release when it is newer than this program, for example v0.2.0. It is empty when no newer release exists, and for a local build

Release.description: Release is the newest release of Mobius.

RepositoryCheckup.title: RepositoryCheckup
RepositoryCheckup.description: RepositoryCheckup is the status of each Mobius label in a repository.

base_version.description: BaseVersion is the id of the newest version when the edit started, and 0 when the file had no version

text.description: Text is the new text of the memory file

message.description: Message is the id of the last message that the Owner saw

organization.description: Organization is the owner of the repository, or the organization of the Triager chat

repository.description: Repository is the repository of the Workstream as "owner/name". It is empty for the Triager chat

workstream.description: Workstream is the number of the Workstream issue. It is 0 for the Triager chat

id.description: ID is the id that the browser gives to the message. A message with an id that another message has is not stored again, and the response is the same

images.description: Images are the images of the message, PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, each at most 5 MB

organization.description: Organization is the owner of the repository, or the organization of the Triager chat

repository.description: Repository is the repository of the Workstream as "owner/name". It is empty for the Triager chat

text.description: Text is the message of the Owner. It is required when the message has no image

workstream.description: Workstream is the number of the Workstream issue. It is 0 for the Triager chat

on.description: On turns Autopilot on when true, and off when false

organization.description: Organization is the owner of the repository, or the organization of the Triager chat

repository.description: Repository is the repository of the Workstream as "owner/name". It is empty for the Triager chat

workstream.description: Workstream is the number of the Workstream issue. It is 0 for the Triager chat

TaskLine.title: TaskLine

blockedBy.title: []Blocker
blockedBy.description: BlockedBy are the open blockers of the task

depth.description: Depth is 0 for a sub-issue of the Workstream issue, and one more for each level below

number.description: Number is the number of the task issue

otherRepository.description: OtherRepository is true for a task in another repository than the Workstream

state.description: State is the Mobius label of the issue with no "mobius:", or open, or closed for a closed issue. A task that waits for a slot shows "queued". A task that waits for CI shows "waits for CI". A task that waits for the Lead shows "waits for Lead". A task that waits for start_implementer shows "waits for start_implementer".

title.description: Title is the title of the task issue

url.description: URL is the GitHub URL of the task issue

TaskLine.description: TaskLine is a task of a Workstream.

ToolCheck.title: ToolCheck

name.description: Name is the name of the program

path.description: Path is the file that Mobius runs. It is empty when Mobius cannot find the program, and for the Claude Code CLI that is built in the adapter

status.description: Status is not-found for a program that Mobius cannot find, and no-version for a program that gives no version. It is empty for a program with a version

version.description: Version is the first line of the version output. It is empty when Status is not empty

ToolCheck.description: ToolCheck is the path and the version of a program that Mobius runs.

TranscriptLine.title: TranscriptLine

body.description: Body is the text below Text. It can be empty

error.description: Error is true for an error row and for a Mobius tool call that failed

folded.description: Folded is true for the first prompt of the session, which starts with the Role prompt

harnessToolName.description: HarnessToolName is the name of a Mobius tool in the Harness, for example mcp__mobius__list_tasks. It is empty for each other row

id.description: ID increases with each new row of all sessions

kind.description: Kind is prompt, update, mcp_call, error, or check for a phase of the local check of an Implementer or a hang of the agent

raw.description: Raw is the JSON text of the row, for example the full ACP update

session.description: Session is the id of the session

text.description: Text is the one line that the UI always shows

time.description: Time is the time of the row

TranscriptLine.description: TranscriptLine is a row of the Transcript of a session.

Unread.title: Unread

count.description: Count is the number of unread messages

organization.description: Organization is the owner of the repository, or the organization of the Triager chat

repository.description: Repository is the repository of the Workstream as "owner/name". It is empty for the Triager chat

workstream.description: Workstream is the number of the Workstream issue. It is 0 for the Triager chat

Unread.description: Unread is the number of unread messages of a chat. The messages of the Owner and the Lead events are never unread.

Upgrade.title: Upgrade

failure.description: Failure is the error of the last upgrade. It is empty when the last upgrade has no error

Upgrade.description: Upgrade is the state of the last upgrade.

Usage.title: Usage

days.title: []UsageDay
days.description: Days are the values of each day and each group, the oldest day first

groups.title: []UsageGroup
groups.description: Groups are the values of each group

options.description: Options are the values that each filter can take, before the filters

totals.description: Totals are the values of all rows that pass the filters

Usage.description: Usage is the token and cost statistics of the turns in a period.

UsageDay.title: UsageDay

day.description: Day is the day of the start of the turns, as "YYYY-MM-DD" in the time zone of the request

group.description: Group is the value of the group, or empty when the request has no group or the value is not set

UsageDay.description: UsageDay is the usage of one group on one day.

UsageGroup.title: UsageGroup

group.description: Group is the value of the group, or empty when the request has no group or the value is not set

UsageGroup.description: UsageGroup is the usage of one group in the period.

UsageOptions.title: UsageOptions

efforts.title: []string
efforts.description: Efforts are the efforts of the rows. A request cannot filter for the rows with no effort

harnesses.title: []string
harnesses.description: Harnesses are the Harnesses of the rows

models.title: []string
models.description: Models are the models that the Harness reports, or the models of the config when the Harness reports none

repositories.title: []string
repositories.description: Repositories are the repositories of the rows as "owner/name"

roles.title: []string
roles.description: Roles are the roles of the rows

UsageOptions.description: UsageOptions are the values that each filter can take in the period.

UsageValues.title: UsageValues

cacheReadTokens.description: CacheReadTokens is the sum of the cache read tokens

cacheWriteTokens.description: CacheWriteTokens is the sum of the cache write tokens

costUsd.description: CostUSD is the sum of the cost in USD

inputTokens.description: InputTokens is the sum of the input tokens

outputTokens.description: OutputTokens is the sum of the output tokens

sessions.description: Sessions is the number of distinct sessions of the rows

UsageValues.description: UsageValues are the sums of the turn usage of a set of rows. A sum of tokens or of cost is null when no row has a value.

ValidationErrorResponse.title: ValidationErrorResponse

details.description: Field-level validation errors (maps field names to arrays of error messages)

ValidationErrorResponse.description: Validation error response with field-level details

Workstream.title: Workstream

allTasksClosed.description: AllTasksClosed is true when the Workstream issue has sub-issues and each one is closed

autopilot.description: Autopilot is true when a trusted user added mobius:autopilot last

brief.description: Brief is the body of the Workstream issue: the goal, the scope and the limits of the Workstream

number.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue

readyToMerge.description: ReadyToMerge is true when the pull request of at least one task of the Workstream waits for the Owner to merge it

repository.description: Repository is the repository of the Workstream issue, as "owner/name"

title.description: Title is the title of the Workstream issue

Workstream.description: Workstream is an open Workstream of a managed repository.

WorkstreamDetails.title: WorkstreamDetails

completedTasks.description: CompletedTasks is the number of closed tasks, with each close reason

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the creation time of the Workstream issue

open.description: Open is true when the Workstream issue is open

openTasks.description: OpenTasks is the number of open tasks

WorkstreamDetails.description: WorkstreamDetails is the details of a Workstream.

number.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue

repository.description: Repository is the repository of the Workstream issue, as "owner/name"

UnprocessableEntity.description: Unprocessable Entity - Request body could not be parsed
